verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review service that processes customer code, so a training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a no-training commitment, a data-usage policy or an opt-out control. The memory feature that learns from historical reviewer comments is a different capability and does not address model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
